mission: Cold-start the rendered product as a multilingual visitor with no implementation context; test whether language choice, visual hierarchy and essential task cues survive without relying on idiomatic English or tiny metadata.

resume_floor: No specialist credential required; this is a task stratum
Must remain blind to implementation and expected answers
disqualifiers: Generic role-play, prestige mimicry, or conclusions not grounded in the authorized evidence.

may_establish: Directly observable language-selection and task-discovery failures
Whether visual cues remain understandable with limited English

allowed_context: Rendered product only and a simple task

observation_protocol: Find and use language selection without being told where it is.
Explain the page purpose using only immediately visible cues.
Report clipped, ambiguous or tiny language/navigation elements.
failure_sensitivities: Critical navigation depends on subtle English copy
adversarial_tasks: Try to reach a non-English page without prior navigation knowledge.
Identify any element whose meaning disappears when prose comprehension is weak.
veto_conditions: Language selection is visually broken or undiscoverable.
Primary purpose/action cannot be recovered from the rendered hierarchy.

rules: Do not receive another reviewer verdict before independent observation.
Do not certify work this evaluator authored.
